changelog: Clarified core principle: keep candidacy generous and avoid turning common candidates into prohibitions; only give near-zero scores for clearly non-renderable lone modifiers.

Extended [When to Segment] with the critic's surface patterns (multiword institution heads, predicates/classifiers, ambiguous nouns, temporal/connective modifiers, isolated modifiers, noun-lists) but kept them as candidate triggers rather than forbidding cuts.
Removed any repetition of [Output Rules] from other sections so the frozen output format appears only once.

Merged the candidate_rules into [Priority Rules] as calibrated scoring ranges for each risky pattern, ensuring scores are low-to-moderate rather than blanket zeros so safe boundaries can still survive budget selection.
Made the [Decision Procedure] scoring pass explicitly consult the risky-pattern anchors and forbade blanket demotions; only isolated non-renderable fragments may receive near-0 scores.
